description: Search the ShowMeStepByStep tutorial corpus by free-text query. Searches across tutorial titles, descriptions, and step content. Returns slim summaries with TL;DRs and canonical URLs. Tenant-aware. Optional filters narrow by category, difficulty, or maximum duration.

categorySlug.description: Optional category to restrict the search to (e.g. 'cooking', 'crochet'). Use list_categories to see available slugs.

maxDurationMinutes.description: Optional ceiling on tutorial total duration. Useful for 'quick recipes' / 'under 10 min' queries.

name: search_tutorials
